[w1] Eight patterns, two departures, four open joints — written as the ground the world already stands on, not as a proposal. One protects the geometry from removal; the other names a removal of geometry as the project's best move. Marking this adopts both, seam included, unless the seam is ruled first. Under the freeze this is disclosure, not an ask — the machine authored nothing here and offers nothing further.
→ hold — read it again before marking

[g2] THE FRESH DEVELOPMENT — mine, tagged reached, borrowing every gift above and recreating none of their structures. Not a hub with menus. The cuboctahedron is the map; the entry tetra holds the whole at every face, so no room is upstream of another and there is no sequence to be behind on. WRITING IS THE ONLY CURRENCY. Nothing enters a room that you did not write. There is no inventory that fills from elsewhere, no drop table, no reward. The economy is one substance and you make all of it. EVERY ROOM SHOWS ITS HAND BEFORE IT ASKS. You see everything the room holds, in full, before any control appears. This is the widget gift moved into a game: no fog of war over the thing you are deciding about. EVERY ROOM HAS A RETURNING DOOR. One surface per arrangement gives back what reaches it, untaken and unlogged. Refusal is a wall you can walk through, not a menu item — and because it takes nothing, using it costs nothing. NOTHING ACTS UNTIL YOU MARK IT, AND THE MARK IS CAUGHT FIRST. The mark lands durably before the world moves; if the world fails to move, the mark still stands. That is the marks gift and the brake gift fused. THE RULES YOU CANNOT BREAK ARE ROOMS, NOT TEXT. No rulebook, no tutorial, no reminder. If something must not happen there is no door to it. That is the tools gift stated as level design. WHAT YOU BUILD RUNS WITHOUT YOU. A world can be handed over whole and works in someone else's hands with none of you required to operate it. SELF-DIRECTED MEANS: no quest log, no objective marker, no XP, no completion state — those are all pattern 4's forbidden resting-place wearing game clothes. The direction comes from which room you walked into and what you wrote when you got there. WHAT THIS DOES NOT YET HAVE, and I am not going to paper over it: no verb. Rooms, currency, doors and refusal are all structure — nothing above says what you actually DO minute to minute that is fun. That is the one hole, it is the difference between this and a game, and it is not mine to fill by inference.

[readingback] THE TETRAHEDRON JSON STORES — read the schema (Ari_Tal_handoff/tetrahedron.schema.json) and the architecture.json instance in full. These are NOT geometric-net material. They're RI Kit practitioner-diagnostic instruments: four vertices = structural capacities of a built system, six edges = named tensions between them, four faces = failure states, four thresholds = high/low reads. The architecture one literally governs 'whether a built structure holds under independent use, without the architect present' — organizational/practitioner diagnosis, not solid geometry. They share the 4/6/4/1 SHAPE with NESI's tetra-body (same minimum-system pattern, independently arrived at — this adds a sixth confirmed sighting of that form in the corpus) but carry none of NESI's actual content, and nothing in them touches the cuboctahedron, the two-cupola net, or the seam. Verdict: NOT the missing piece for the entry-tetra/net collision. That collision is a specific fact about how the cupola split cuts the cuboctahedron's two inscribed tetrahedra — a claim about one solid's geometry. These five JSON files are a different instrument entirely, wearing the same skeleton. Worth keeping as further confirmation the 4-6-4-1 form recurs corpus-wide; not worth chasing further for this specific collision.

THE MENU.GD / PROTOCOLS.MD REFERENT QUESTION — read nesi/world3d/scripts/menu/menu.gd in full (252 lines, Kevin's mark 2026-08-07). It is a real, built instance of a recurring convention in the retired 3D world: EVERY screen renders as a tetra — 'the world is one, the stations stand in one, and the menu is one' (the file's own comment). Four vertices, unslotted ones drawn hollow and left empty ('blank is a complete state'), read by presence/absence of what's behind them, never by a label. This is structurally close to what PROTOCOLS.md gestures at with 'the rooms and windows are built from the format Kevin has already produced' — but the vocabulary doesn't match (PROTOCOLS says 'rooms and windows'; menu.gd says 'vertices' and 'screens'), and menu.gd is 3D-world material from before the 2D ruling, not something built for the 2D net specifically. Honest answer: this is the strongest CANDIDATE family for what that line means — a real, repeated, Kevin-marked convention for how a screen with empty slots should look and behave — but PROTOCOLS.md itself says the referent 'is not stated and is not inferred,' and I'm not going to be the one who infers it. Naming the candidate, not closing the question.
